document.title: Google Workspace Migration - CoverManager to Zenchef
document.subtitle: Tenant Consolidation: Full Organization Migration

customer.industry: Restaurant booking and guest management software
customer.profile: Zenchef and CoverManager are consolidating into a single entity, with everything to sit under Zenchef. Zenchef operates the destination Google Workspace tenant (zenchef.com); CoverManager operates the source tenant (covermanager.com) and holds the users, data and GCP projects in scope. The engagement merges the CoverManager tenant into Zenchef's, with covermanager.com added to the Zenchef tenant so every user keeps their existing address.

background.objective: Zenchef is engaging Premier Cloud Inc., a Google Cloud Premier Partner, to consolidate the CoverManager Google Workspace tenant into the Zenchef tenant as part of a corporate merger of the two entities. The entire CoverManager organization is in scope. covermanager.com is added to the Zenchef tenant as a secondary domain so that every user keeps their existing @covermanager.com address, and historical mail, Drive, shared drive, calendar and contact data is transferred with CloudM Migrate ahead of a single out-of-hours cutover.

key_focus_areas.label: Address Continuity
key_focus_areas.text: covermanager.com moves to the Zenchef tenant as a secondary domain. Every user keeps the same address; no mailbox renaming and no alias-domain substitution.

key_focus_areas.label: Historical Data Migration
key_focus_areas.text: CloudM Migrate transfers mail, My Drive, shared drives, calendar and contacts from the covermanager.com tenant into pre-created placeholder accounts in the zenchef.com tenant. Nothing is deleted from the source.

key_focus_areas.label: Minimal Cutover Downtime
key_focus_areas.text: Background sync runs while users continue working normally; the domain move, rename and DKIM change happen out of hours, with a short mail interruption and a final delta pass afterwards.

key_focus_areas.label: GCP Continuity
key_focus_areas.text: The CoverManager GCP organization, its projects, billing and service accounts are reviewed separately from the Workspace migration. The OAuth project is moved rather than recreated, and a minimum footprint is retained in the old tenant to keep the GCP organization alive.

background.engagement_type: This is an execution engagement. Premier Cloud performs the migration end to end, including environment scan, placeholder creation, background sync, cutover and the final delta, with defined preparation and post-migration tasks owned by the Customer.

migration.plan_note: The phase list, task split, decisions taken and open questions are maintained jointly by Premier Cloud and the Customer in the shared migration tracker, which both parties treat as the single source of truth for delivery.

volumes.label: Source accounts
volumes.notes: 5 suspended and 2 archived. 20 active accounts flagged for review (no login in 90+ days or never). 262 accounts proposed to migrate after cleanup. Admin SDK export, 28/10/2026.

volumes.label: Shared / service mailboxes
volumes.notes: Administration, billing, support, legal, DPO, marketing, noreply and similar. Regular licensed users, not Google Groups. 7 accounts exceed 100 GB, mostly shared mailboxes; the largest single account is approximately 580 GB.

volumes.label: Groups and aliases
volumes.notes: 4 groups have external members; 2 groups are empty.

volumes.label: Shared drives
volumes.notes: Confirmed by the Customer on 29/10/2026 from Admin Console reports dated 27/10/2026.

volumes.label: Total data volume
volumes.notes: Gmail approximately 1.9 TB; My Drive approximately 2.5 TB; shared drives approximately 1.0 TB; Google Photos approximately 80 GB.

decisions_pending: Confirmation that covermanager.com will be added to the Zenchef tenant as a secondary domain and not as an alias domain (tracker Q3).
Dedicated super admin accounts for Premier Cloud on both the source and destination tenants, which the Customer has stated will be created once this SOW is signed (tracker T6, T7, Q11).
Owner for rebuilding SAML applications and domain-wide delegation on the destination tenant (tracker T12, Q5).
Owner for rebuilding routing, content compliance and email-to-case on the destination tenant, and whether these can be tested before cutover (tracker T11, Q6).
Owner and sequencing for moving the OAuth GCP project into the Zenchef organization, before or after cutover (tracker T14, Q9).
The minimum licences and super admin accounts to retain in the CoverManager tenant so the GCP organization stays alive, and who owns decommissioning the remainder (tracker T12 timeline row, Q10).

Zenchef tenant-wide settings that will apply to migrated users - outbound gateway or relay, spam handling, SSO and external forwarding - and whether CoverManager gets a dedicated OU with delegated admin rights (tracker Q7, Q8, for Zenchef).
